components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard call-to-action button with sharp corners and solid black fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #121212; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 48px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #121212; border-radius: 0px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; color: #121212; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Text input field with sharp corners and black border outline on active state.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #121212; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #121212; border-radius: 0px; outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-width 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border: 2px solid #121212; padding: 13px 15px; }

narrative.overview: The Hype-Drop design system is built on Swiss-style modernist typography and raw, uncompromising editorial restraint. The canvas relies entirely on contrast, typography, and precise spatial layout rather than decorative gradients, shadows, or rounded elements. It is clean, bold, cold, and highly confident—positioning the storefront as a high-end streetwear editorial catalog.
keyCharacteristics: Pure Monochromatic Palette: Dominated by pure white (#FFFFFF) and solid black (#121212).
Zero Radii Geometry: Every input, button, card, image, and popup has a sharp 0px border-radius.
Flat Elevation: No drop-shadows are used. Surfaces are layered strictly through solid borders.

rules.name: The 10% Contrast Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors are entirely banned. Pure black must carry at least 90% of the text and active state fills. Gray is reserved strictly for minor containers and borders.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows, blurs, and glassmorphism are strictly prohibited. Visual depth is established by solid black boundaries and flat background changes.

dos: Do use exact 0px border-radius globally on every interface element.
Do use high typographic weight contrast (e.g. Extra Bold Display next to Light Body).
Do use solid black 1px borders to separate content blocks instead of shadows.
donts: Don't use any rounded corners (e.g., border-radius greater than 0px).
Don't use drop-shadows or gradients on buttons, cards, images, or sections.
Don't use marketing buzzwords like 'unleash', 'supercharge', or 'leverage'.
